evidence.topology: Python AST import analysis; package __init__ re-export imports excluded from aggregated dependency counts.
evidence.execution_flows: Explicit semantic overlays reviewed against estimator orchestration modules; not presented as import edges.

nodes.label: Compatibility shim
nodes.description: Preserves older reghdfe-style Python workflows so empirical projects can migrate without changing the econometric specification.

nodes.label: Public interface & orchestration
nodes.description: Turns an empirical specification into the appropriate OLS, IV, PPML or IV-PPML workflow and manages repeated-specification research workflows.

nodes.label: Frontend validation
nodes.description: Checks that outcomes, regressors, instruments, fixed effects, clusters and weights have economically valid roles before estimation.

nodes.label: Econometric data layer
nodes.description: Projects, encodes and reuses only the raw observations/columns needed by the empirical specification while preserving sample identity.

nodes.label: Execution planner
nodes.description: Separates exactness certificates from resource/cost policy and chooses memory, representation and parallel execution without changing the estimand.

nodes.label: Shared contracts
nodes.description: Keeps estimator choices, inference conventions and paper-facing results consistent across model families.

nodes.label: OLS model
nodes.description: Estimates linear partial effects while controlling for high-dimensional observed heterogeneity; supplies OLS-specific resampling inference.

nodes.label: Linear IV model
nodes.description: Handles endogenous regressors in linear models and reports whether excluded instruments provide credible identifying variation.

nodes.label: PPML model
nodes.description: Estimates nonnegative outcomes such as trade flows with multiplicative conditional means, high-dimensional FE and separation-safe inference.

nodes.label: IV-PPML model
nodes.description: Addresses endogeneity in multiplicative/PPML models and finite-panel bias while retaining high-dimensional fixed effects.

nodes.label: Shared model primitives
nodes.description: Provides the common Poisson mean/link calculations used by PPML and IV-PPML so both models implement the same economic outcome process.

nodes.label: HDFE infrastructure
nodes.description: Controls for large sets of fixed effects and heterogeneous FE structures without estimating/reporting every nuisance coefficient explicitly.

nodes.label: Generic IV primitives
nodes.description: Represents the exclusion restrictions and orthogonality conditions that identify endogenous effects, independently of the outcome model.

nodes.label: Resampling engine
nodes.description: Runs bootstrap/resampling procedures used to quantify sampling uncertainty without embedding estimator-specific economic assumptions.

nodes.label: Cluster inference
nodes.description: Supports credible inference when shocks are correlated within economic groups and cluster counts/balance make asymptotics fragile.

nodes.label: Compute/runtime kernels
nodes.description: Executes the sufficient-statistic and matrix operations behind estimation while exploiting data structure so large empirical designs remain feasible.

flows.label: OLS-HDFE
flows.description: Estimate linear partial effects net of high-dimensional observed heterogeneity, then construct the requested inference.
steps: Validate variable roles and data contract
Use grouped projection and numerical kernels
Assemble covariance and stable result/reporting contracts

flows.label: Linear IV-HDFE
flows.description: Identify linear causal/structural effects with excluded instruments while partialling out high-dimensional confounders.
steps: Build instrument design and weighted IV solve
Concentrate fixed effects and compute absorbed DoF
Assemble estimates and reportable IV diagnostics

flows.label: PPML-HDFE
flows.description: Estimate multiplicative conditional-mean effects for nonnegative outcomes while absorbing high-dimensional heterogeneity and handling separation.
steps: Validate Poisson outcome, exposure and FE inputs
Assemble PPML result and publication output

flows.label: IV-PPML-HDFE
flows.description: Identify endogenous effects in multiplicative/PPML models using excluded instruments and high-dimensional fixed effects.
steps: Evaluate additive IV moments / weighted 2SLS step
Optional model-specific bootstrap delegates draw mechanics

flows.label: Heterogeneous specifications
flows.description: Accelerate event-study, group-specific-slope and interaction-rich specifications without changing the requested heterogeneous coefficients.
steps: Compile explicit coefficient heterogeneity before dense expansion
Certify FE row topology and retain only locally active coefficient support
Project nuisance FE within certified components
Feed compact design to OLS when economically equivalent
Feed compact role designs to linear IV when economically equivalent
Feed compact design to PPML while retaining global convergence/separation semantics
Feed compact exogenous/endogenous/instrument designs to IV-PPML
Fallback to pooled dense execution whenever exactness or benefit is not certified

flows.label: Execution planning
flows.description: Choose a feasible physical execution for a fixed econometric specification without allowing performance heuristics to alter identification or the estimand.
steps: Compile required raw columns and reusable data roles
Report projected payload and memory requirements
Report exact FE topology and parallel work geometry
Report certified physical representations and workspace candidates
Choose memory/representation/thread policy among exact candidates
Expose explainable execution metadata without changing statistical output

flows.label: Repeated specifications
flows.description: Accelerate common empirical robustness workflows that repeatedly change outcomes, controls or FE sets across regression-table columns.
steps: Cache encoded FE combinations and reusable absorber state
Dispatch repeated OLS specifications when requested
Dispatch repeated linear-IV specifications when requested
Reuse within-transformed columns and execution context
Assemble each specification result with shared-state metadata

invariants: compute is estimator-agnostic and must not import HDFE, IV, or model implementations.
hdfe may use compute, but numerical FE canonicalization/core reduction must not rewrite the requested inference topology.
generic iv remains outcome-model agnostic; linear-IV and IV-PPML model layers consume it rather than importing one another.
resampling owns draw mechanics only; estimator/inference-specific statistics remain outside resampling.
standard CRV1 covariance remains in compute/VCE; advanced cluster diagnostics and WCR/WCU live in inference/cluster.
public boundaries expose structured EconHDFEError codes without masking programmer failures.
pyreghdfe is a compatibility surface; canonical implementation lives under econhdfe.

codemap.task: Choose the estimator implied by the empirical specification
Validate economic variable roles before estimation
Compile factor interactions / event-study / group-specific slopes
Reuse work across regression-table robustness specifications
Count absorbed nuisance parameters / residual degrees of freedom
Represent exclusion restrictions and IV orthogonality conditions
Estimate endogenous linear effects and diagnose weak instruments
Estimate multiplicative effects for nonnegative outcomes / trade flows
Estimate endogenous multiplicative effects and panel-bias corrections
Construct robust/clustered uncertainty and weighted least-squares sufficient statistics
Diagnose cluster quality and few-cluster sensitivity
Return stable paper-facing estimates, diagnostics and structured failures
